title: Veniamin Dubrovin – winner of the Federation Cup 2026!
excerpt: Veniamin Dubrovin has won the Federation Cup 2026, one of the four prestigious national tournaments in Moldovan table tennis.
body_html:
Today Veniamin Dubrovin showed a level of skill worthy of respect and of being followed as an example, taking the title at the national table tennis tournament “Federation Cup”, one of the four most prestigious national tournaments in the sport.

His run through the competition was solid and convincing. In the semi-finals Veniamin Dubrovin beat Denis Țerna 3:1, and in the final he won again 3:1 in a tough match against Igor Ni.

It is worth noting that both Denis Țerna and Veniamin Dubrovin are members of the Republic of Moldova national team that has qualified for the World Table Tennis Championships London 2026, which gives this match extra sporting value and underlines the high level of the competition.

This performance confirms Veniamin Dubrovin’s consistency, sporting maturity and standing among the strongest players in national table tennis.
